# Release Readiness Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that release-readiness criteria are complete, evidence-bound, and decidable only by a human.
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [ADRs](../../../docs/adr/README.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Item tags**: `[Mandatory]` means the criterion derives from the constitution, an approved requirement, or an accepted ADR or ruling. `[Optional]` means it concerns an enhancement. `[Dnn]` refers to a detection from the checklist brief; the detection map is in [../gates/release-evidence-gates.md](../gates/release-evidence-gates.md). Post-implementation evidence checks are in that gates file, not here. Every item is unchecked, including `[Optional]` items, so `/speckit-implement` reports this file as incomplete until a reviewer marks it.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is release readiness defined as evaluating all ten CON XI conditions? [Completeness, CON XI; Spec §FR-GOV-010] [D31] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the release-blocking conditions enumerated (mandatory FAIL, unapproved or expired exception, unexecuted tests, missing scans)? [Completeness, Governance §6; policy-set.v1.yaml release_blocking] [D09] [D12] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the evidence required for each readiness condition named? [Measurability, CON XI] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the presentation of fallback use (degraded artifacts) at readiness specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-ORC-016; policy-set.v1.yaml REL-005] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK005 Is residual-risk acceptance required for open risks? [Completeness, CON XI condition 8; Plan §5.1] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is it specified that readiness becomes "ready" only through a recorded human decision, never through an agent? [Clarity, Spec §FR-GOV-011; Governance §6] [D15] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK007 Are run-level readiness (G-RELEASE) and repository-level readiness (docs/release-readiness.md sign-off) distinguished, each with its own criteria? [Clarity, Plan §5.2] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the minimum defensible release outcome specified, including that a truthful FAIL is acceptable and an unsupported PASS is not? [Clarity, Plan §14.5] [D31] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK009 Are scan thresholds and the requirement to record scan execution quantified? [Measurability, PVT-012; Spec §FR-GOV-012] [Mandatory]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK010 Is the effect of unresolved documentation discrepancies on repository readiness specified (NFR-DOC-001 target: 0 unresolved at release), given REL-004 covers run documentation only? [Consistency, Spec §NFR-DOC-001 (CR-003); policy-set.v1.yaml REL-004] [D30] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK011 Are stop conditions STOP-1 to STOP-5 tied to how readiness is reported? [Consistency, Plan §14.4] [Mandatory]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- `[Gap]` = the requirement is missing; `[Ambiguity]` = the term or rule needs a definition; `[Conflict]` = two sources disagree; `[Assumption]` = relies on an unvalidated assumption
